title.zh: v2.14.0 编排优先：补完歌曲模型（clips + 时间轴），手机明确为功能子集，音质改进变成可降的门禁
title.en: v2.14.0 Arrangement First: the Song Model (Clips + a Timeline), the Phone as an Explicit Subset, and the Audio-Quality Work as a Ratchet

highlights.zh: **先回答那个问题：是的，而且应该提前——理由不是「DAW 很酷」，而是剩下的大部分音质改进没有时间轴就写不出来。** 现在的渲染器只接受一个 `bars` 参数，把**同一个 pattern 重复 N 次**（`totalSteps = patternSteps * bars`），所以导出 4 小节就是四个一模一样的小节——这正是那份试听报告听到的「无限循环机器」。「第 4 小节加 fill」「每 8 小节换一次和弦」「做一个 riser」全都是关于**时间轴**的陈述，单小节 pattern 里根本无处安放。
highlights.en: **Answering the question first: yes, and it should be pulled forward — not because a DAW is nice, but because most of the remaining audio-quality work is not expressible without a timeline.** The renderer takes a `bars` argument and **repeats one pattern** (`totalSteps = patternSteps * bars`), so a four-bar export is four identical bars — exactly the "infinite loop machine" the listening report heard. "Add a fill in bar 4", "change the chord every 8 bars", "build a riser" ar…

highlights.zh: **而且它比看起来便宜得多，因为接缝早就在了。** `GrooveProject` 一直带着 `patterns: { A, B }`、`songMode` 与 `songChain: ("A" | "B")[]`——但 grep 显示 `songChain` 只出现在类型、持久化层和一个弹窗的 prop 里：**没有任何东西渲染或播放它**。编排是一个「有记录、没引擎」的承诺，所以这轮是**把一个已经存在的概念补完**，而不是从零造 DAW。
highlights.en: **And it is far cheaper than it looked, because the seam was already there.** `GrooveProject` has carried `patterns: { A, B }`, `songMode` and `songChain: ("A" | "B")[]` for a while — but a grep shows `songChain` only in the type, the persistence layer and a modal prop: **nothing renders or plays it**. The arrangement is a record with no engine, so this is finishing an existing concept rather than building a DAW from scratch.

highlights.zh: **这一轮的实件（编排计划的 B0）。** ① `src/types/song.ts`：`Song`（clips + sections）、`SongSection`（槽位、重复小节数、逐段静音与力度缩放）、`resolveTimeline`（把编排摊成逐小节的时间轴，**报告问题而不是抛异常**，所以半成品编排也能被显示）、增删改复制 section 的函数，以及历史 `songChain` 的双向迁移。② 10 条单测把迁移钉死：**今天保存的工程明天打开，小节数与顺序完全一致**。③ `docs/ARRANGEMENT_PLAN.md`：模型、六个步骤（B1 持久化 → B2 渲染器时间轴 → B3 编排视图 → B4 导出器 → B5 音质收益 → B6 MCP），以及手机范围的**子集契约**。
highlights.en: **What landed (B0 of the arrangement plan).** (1) `src/types/song.ts`: `Song` (clips + sections), `SongSection` (slot, repeat count, per-section mutes and velocity scale), `resolveTimeline` (flattens the arrangement into a bar-by-bar timeline that **reports problems instead of throwing**, so a half-built song can still be displayed), section add/update/duplicate/remove, and migration to and from the historical `songChain`.
